Source inputs

TDLib license: Boost Software License 1.0

OpenSSL version: 3.5.7 LTS
OpenSSL repository: https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git
OpenSSL commit: 8cf17aaeb4599f8af87fefd810b5b5fee90fe69e
OpenSSL license: Apache License 2.0

The build uses TDLib's official example/android/build-openssl.sh and
example/android/build-tdlib.sh scripts from the pinned commit. The recipe
changes only the OpenSSL source URL from a mutable tag archive to the exact
commit archive and limits the script ABI loops to arm64-v8a and x86_64.

TDLib CMake configuration from the pinned official script:
-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<NDK>/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake
-DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=<OpenSSL output>/<ABI>
-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
-GNinja
-DANDROID_ABI=<ABI>
-DANDROID_STL=c++_static
-DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-16
-DTD_ANDROID_JSON=ON

NDK r28 adds the 16 KB linker behavior. The observed final link included
-z now, -z relro, and -z max-page-size=16384 for both outputs.

The output hashes are release gates. Rebuilds must not replace these files
unless their source inputs, toolchain record, licenses, hashes, and ELF
verification results are updated together and reviewed.
